name: Chylomicron lipolysis and clearance by lipoprotein lipases
rationale: All members concern LPL/hepatic lipase hydrolysis of triglyceride and phospholipid in chylomicrons and their clearance, whereas confusables centre on VLDL assembly/clearance, LDL/HDL remodeling or LXR lipogenesis.

qualifier: miRNA/ceRNA translational control of specific targets
name: MicroRNA silencing and translational control of target mRNAs
rationale: Members cover miRNA biogenesis, RISC and miRNA/ceRNA/RNA-binding-protein control of specific mRNAs (PTEN, CDH1, PD-L1, NPAS4), unlike confusables built on ARE-mediated decay, siRNA, decapping or 3'-end processing.

core: Branching organ morphogenesis via epithelial-mesenchymal signaling
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung, prostate and salivary morphogenesis
rationale: Members share epithelial-mesenchymal interaction driving branching and bud morphogenesis of lung, trachea, prostate and salivary/lacrimal glands, while confusables are mammary, pancreatic and gonadal development.

name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling and TGFBR/SMAD2/3 cancer mutants
rationale: Members combine Hippo/YAP-TAZ growth control with TGF-beta receptor and SMAD2/3 cancer mutants, the latter absent from the Hippo-only confusables and differing from the SMAD4/TGFBR mutant set of C4.

name: Cytosolic nucleic acid sensing driving IRF3 type I interferon induction
rationale: Members share RIG-I/MDA5, ZBP1 and cytosolic DNA sensing feeding IRF3 type I IFN induction, unlike confusables centred on OAS effectors, IRF7/TLR signaling or RLR negative regulation.

name: Interleukin-33, -36, -38 and interleukin-17 signaling
rationale: All members are receptor signaling by IL-1 family cytokines IL-33/36/38 or IL-17, distinguishing the theme from confusables about IL-18, IL-1 processing, Th17 commitment or IL-23/IL-12.

qualifier: smooth muscle phenotypic switching, endothelial shear stress
name: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching and endothelial shear stress response
rationale: Members cover VSMC proliferation, migration, dedifferentiation and SRF targets plus endothelial shear-stress responses, unlike confusables about angiogenesis/VEGF or cardiac muscle growth.

name: Sperm flagellum assembly and motility during spermiogenesis
rationale: Members share sperm axoneme, mitochondrial sheath and manchette assembly and sperm motility, whereas confusables concern general motile cilia, ciliogenesis/IFT, germ cell development or tubulin modification.

core: Nuclear pore complex and nucleocytoplasmic transport
qualifier: SUMO conjugation, mitotic nuclear envelope cycle
name: Nuclear pore transport, mitotic envelope remodeling and SUMOylation
rationale: Members combine NPC-mediated import/export, mitotic NPC and nuclear envelope disassembly/reformation, and SUMO conjugation of nuclear targets, unlike confusables centred on ESCRT envelope sealing or mRNA export.

qualifier: MHC expression and T cell antigen presentation
name: Interferon-gamma-induced MHC expression and T cell antigen presentation
rationale: Members share IFN-gamma-driven MHC class I/II regulation and antigen presentation to CD8 T cells, whereas confusables emphasize Th1 differentiation, IL-12 or IFNG receptor signaling.

name: CaMK-CREB synapse-to-nucleus signaling in memory
rationale: Members link NMDAR-driven CaMKII/CaMKIV/CaMKK-AMPK signaling to CREB and NPAS4 transcription and memory/LTP, unlike confusables on cAMP-PKA, NMDA receptor biology or MECP2.

name: Tight junction regulation of barrier and paracellular permeability
rationale: Members share tight junction assembly, disassembly and paracellular barrier control in endothelium and epithelium, distinct from confusables about adherens junctions, cadherin adhesion or mechanosensing.

name: Selenium metabolism, selenoprotein synthesis and thyroid hormone activation
rationale: Members cover dietary selenium metabolism, selenocysteine synthesis/readthrough and selenoprotein-dependent thyroid hormone generation, unlike confusables on sulfonation, ROS detox or thyroid hormone receptor signaling.

name: Cullin neddylation, COP9 deneddylation and RHOBTB adaptor cycles
rationale: Members share cullin-RING ligase regulation by neddylation/CSN deneddylation including CUL3-adaptor RHOBTB cycles, unlike confusables on PD-L1 degradation, K11 chains or general proteolysis.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling in cardiac excitation-contraction coupling
rationale: Members concern ryanodine-receptor release, SERCA reuptake, Na/Ca exchange and T-tubules controlling cardiac contraction and relaxation, unlike confusables on store-operated calcium entry or fiber-type and heart-rate regulation.

name: Mitochondrial fission-fusion balance and PINK1-Parkin mitophagy
rationale: Members share regulation of mitochondrial fission/fusion and depolarisation-triggered PINK1-Parkin mitophagy, whereas confusables concern mitochondrial protein targeting/membrane potential or receptor-mediated mitophagy.

qualifier: ROCK, PAK and citron effector activation
name: Rho GTPase cycles and ROCK, PAK, citron effector activation
rationale: Members are the RHO/RAC/CDC42/RND GTPase cycles and their effector activation, with ROCK, PAK and citron kinase effectors separating the theme from its nearest actin-cytoskeleton confusable.

name: G-beta-gamma and Rac signaling in leukocyte chemotaxis
rationale: Members share G-beta-gamma to PI3Kgamma/PLCbeta and RAC1/2/RHOH signaling, including NADPH oxidase activation, in leukocyte chemotaxis and homing, unlike confusables on chemokines, T cell synapse or CXCR4.

name: Interleukin-6 family cytokine signaling via STAT3 and ERK
rationale: Members are gp130 cytokine (IL-6, LIF, CNTF) signaling through STAT3 and ERK1/2, distinct from confusables on IL-11/IL-27, IL-2-family STAT5 or CSF1 signaling.

name: Gonadotropin control of ovarian cycle and testicular development
rationale: Members share LH/FSH secretion and response governing ovulation, luteinization, Leydig/Sertoli development and germ cell proliferation, unlike confusables on oocyte maturation, activin or glycoprotein hormone ligands.

name: Polyubiquitin chain assembly and proteasomal protein degradation
rationale: Members share E3-mediated polyubiquitination with diverse chain linkages and proteasomal/degron-rule degradation, unlike confusables on deubiquitination/neddylation, ERAD quality control or ribosome-associated QC.

name: Sex steroid biosynthesis and steroidogenic CYP defects
rationale: Members cover pregnenolone, progesterone, androgen and estrogen synthesis and steroidogenic CYP deficiencies, while confusables centre on glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid synthesis.

name: mTORC1 regulation by amino acids and energy status
rationale: All members concern mTORC1 activation and its control by amino acids and LKB1-AMPK energy sensing, whereas confusables are amino acid transport or p53 metabolic targets.

name: Influenza viral RNA synthesis and nuclear vRNP assembly
rationale: Members are influenza vRNA/mRNA synthesis and vRNP complexes in the host nucleus, distinct from coronavirus replicase and HIV integration confusables.

name: Sympathoadrenal neural crest development and catecholamine biosynthesis
rationale: Members share neural crest/endothelin-driven autonomic and enteric development with sympathetic, adrenal and catecholamine synthesis, the latter absent from the RET/GDNF and gut-motility confusables.
